entities.name: Stanislaus of Szczepanów
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Stanislaus of Szczepanów was a Polish Catholic prelate who served as Bishop of Kraków and was martyred by the Polish King Bolesław II the Bold. He is the patron saint of Poland.
